_comment: Seed BGM library shipped with the image. Every track carries a recorded license and source; the asset tree copies these fields into asset metadata at seed time (duration_seconds / license / source are required).
attribution_note: When a seeded track is used in a render, keep the attribution string with the delivered asset (it is propagated into the asset metadata under bgm.attribution).
